column1: # mapping_set_title: "OMOP concept_id to SNOMED CT code"

# mapping_set_description: "Identifier bridge from OMOP concept_ids to the SNOMED CT codes they were loaded from. Same semantics as omop2loinc: the OMOP concept_id is a surrogate key for a term taken verbatim from SNOMED CT, so subject and object denote the same concept and the predicate is skos:exactMatch. Scope: the 118 SNOMED-sourced concepts in the BDC priority measurement set. All 118 are standard and valid concepts. Generated automatically by a vocabulary-table join, hence semapv:UnspecifiedMatching. OUTPUT_TIER=open. OPEN TIER ARTIFACT - all label columns are deliberately blank. SNOMED CT description text is UMLS-license-gated and is not openly redistributable; the SCTID codes themselves are referenceable (Mondo distributes SCTIDs). Note that for a SNOMED-sourced OMOP concept the OMOP concept_name IS SNOMED description text, so subject_label is blanked alongside object_label. Regenerate with OUTPUT_TIER=restricted, into a license-gated destination only, to populate labels."
